curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover work zone speed and double fines, why speed drives crash severity, what posted limits and minimums mean, and when to slow below the limit.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast card for driving too slowly.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on choosing a safe, legal speed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the default limits for mountain roads, business and residence districts, trash haulers, and urban and rural highways.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per limit; contrast cards for the two mountain limits and the two district limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz matching a road type to its default limit.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define stopping distance, show how space ahead prevents sudden stops, why hard braking is risky, and a sample stopping distance.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each idea; contrast card for causes of sudden stops.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on stopping distance and following space.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the parts of a proper turn, when signals are required, signal distances, the three-second rule of thumb, and hand signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each signaling rule; contrast card for distance versus seconds.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on when and how far to signal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach right and left turn starting positions, multiple turn lanes, where to end a turn, and common path errors.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each path rule; contrast card for start versus finish positions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on correct turning paths.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain why left turns are risky, where to wait, why not to creep into the intersection, and why wheels stay straight.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast card for the safe waiting position.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on waiting to turn left.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover U-turn rules, reverse and forward two-point turnabouts, and when and how to do a three-point turnabout.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each maneuver; contrast card comparing the three ways to reverse direction.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on choosing and performing a turnaround.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach securing a parked vehicle, where parking is banned, no-parking distances, and parallel parking in and out.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for gear choice and no-parking distances.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on legal and safe parking.
